questions.scenario: A child is asking his mom about the time to catch a cartoon.
questions.question:
Son: Mom, what time is it?
Mom: __________________. It's time for your cartoon.
questions.explanation: 問時間使用 It is... o'clock。選項 B 漏掉 o'；選項 C 錯用複數；選項 D 錯用動詞 has。
questions.commonMisconception: 漏掉時間表達法中的 o'clock 固定格式。

questions.scenario: A student looking at the classroom clock during a test.
questions.question: Teacher: Don't worry. It's only __________________.
questions.explanation: 整點時間表達為 {數字} o'clock。選項 C 誤將 clock 加了複數 s。
questions.commonMisconception: 將 o'clock 誤認為可數名詞加 s。

questions.scenario: A dad waking up his daughter.
questions.question:
Dad: Wake up! It's __________________.
Daughter: Oh, I'm late for school.
questions.explanation: 陳述現在是幾點，直接用 It is + 時間。選項 C 的 at 用於描述動作發生的確切時刻，而非現在幾點。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 it is {time} 與 at {time} 的句型功能差異。

questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'clock'?
questions.explanation: clock 與 rock 均發短母音 /ɑk/。選項 B 是 /æk/。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到結尾 -ock 的發音一致性。

questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 標準答法為 It's {數字} o'clock。選項 C 變成回答年齡。
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡短回答中混淆時間表達與年齡表達 (I am six)。

questions.scenario: A student asking a librarian about closing time.
questions.question:
Student: __________________?
Librarian: It's five o'clock. We are closing.
questions.explanation: 由回答『It's five o'clock』反推問句是在詢問時間。選項 B, C 疑問詞不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合數值回報 (five o'clock) 推斷正確的 Wh- 疑問詞。

questions.scenario: Looking at an old wall clock.
questions.question:
A: Is that a clock?
B: Yes, __________________. And it is ten o'clock now.
questions.explanation: 對 Is that...? 的肯定回答為 Yes, it is.。選項 C 單複數不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 指示代名詞 that 在回答中需轉換為 it 進行簡答。

questions.question: Which time word has the same short 'i' sound as 'six'?
questions.explanation: six 與 it 均發短母音 /ɪ/。選項 A, B, D 為 /aɪ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆長母音 i_e 與短母音 i 的聽覺與拼寫對應。

questions.scenario: Waking up on a Sunday morning.
questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: It's __________________. Let's sleep more!
questions.explanation: 正確拼寫為 o'clock。選項 C 漏掉撇號且多了 s。
questions.commonMisconception: 對特定時間單字 o'clock 的拼寫細節掌握不精確。

questions.scenario: Pointing at two big clocks in the airport.
questions.question:
A: What are those?
B: They are big __________________.
questions.explanation: 詢問物品實體 (clocks) 應使用名詞複數型。選項 C 是用於報時的副詞性質用法。
questions.commonMisconception: 將具體鐘 (clocks) 與抽象報時用的 o'clock 混淆。

questions.question:
A: Is it two o'clock?
B: No, __________________. Look at the watch.
questions.explanation: 否定回答搭配單數代名詞 it。選項 C 單複數不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 在否定簡答時隨意抓取複數 Be 動詞搭配單數主詞。

questions.scenario: A teacher asking a student about the lesson time.
questions.question:
Teacher: __________________?
Student: It's one o'clock, Teacher.
questions.explanation: 標準問時間句。選項 C 是在問『這是什麼東西』。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別詢問『時間』與詢問『事物』的 Wh- 詞用法。

questions.question: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'o' in 'robot'?
questions.explanation: robot 的第一個 o 發長母音 /o/，與 go 相同。選項 B 是短母音 /ɑ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法辨識多音節單字中母音長短的重音位移效果。

questions.question:
A: Is the bus coming?
B: Yes, it is __________________ now.
questions.explanation: 陳述時間狀態。選項 B 需搭配動詞片語使用。
questions.commonMisconception: 慣性加入 at 於陳述時間的補語位置。

questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: It is __________________.
questions.explanation: 整點十二點。選項 B 複數名詞不應用於報時副詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 不了解報時副詞 o'clock 不可數且為固定片語。

questions.question: Teacher: Listen! /tw/-/e/-/l/-/v/-/e/, twelve. What is the sound of 'e'?
questions.explanation: twelve 中的第一個 e 發短母音 /ɛ/。結尾的 e 不發音。
questions.commonMisconception: 將單字中的不發音 e 與主要發音 mother vowel 混淆。

questions.question:
A: Where is your watch?
B: It's on the table. It is __________________.
questions.explanation: 錶顯示四點。選項 B 為實體複數錶。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別實體物品名稱與時間副詞報時用法。

questions.scenario: A girl is late for a meeting.
questions.question:
Girl: __________________?
Boy: It's eleven o'clock. Hurry up!
questions.explanation: 由催促語 (Hurry up) 與時間回報反推問句。選項 B, C, D 邏輯斷層。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見 Hurry up 所反映出的時間緊迫性提示。

questions.question: Which word has the same vowel sound as in 'up'?
questions.explanation: up 與 duck 均發短母音 /ʌ/。選項 B, C 為長母音。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法藉由拼寫預測短母音的出現。

questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: It's __________________. Time for lunch.
questions.explanation: 午餐時間通常是十二點。選項 B, D 格式破碎。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略生活常規 (lunch time) 與確切時間 (12:00) 的聯想。

questions.scenario: A child pointing to different numbers on a clock.
questions.question: Mom: Look at the small hand. It's at three. So it's __________.
questions.explanation: 時針指向三，代表三點。選項 D 在整句結構中會重複 at。
questions.commonMisconception: 在解釋邏輯中遺漏時間副詞的正確形式。

questions.question:
A: Is it seven o'clock?
B: No, __________________. It's eight.
questions.explanation: 否定回答搭配單數 it。選項 B 為肯否定衝突。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見後半句導正的時間 (It's eight) 的否定意義。

questions.question: Which word has a DIFFERENT vowel sound?
questions.explanation: watch, wash, what 均含有近似 /ɑ/ 的音。back 是短母音 /æ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 被拼寫 a 誤導，認為所有 a 的發音均為 /æ/。

questions.scenario: A student waking up his friend.
questions.question:
Student A: Hurry up! It's one o'clock.
Student B: __________________
Student A: Yes, it's time for music class.
questions.explanation: 再次確認對方剛才報的時間。選項 A 語意重複。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合對話中『再次確認』的情境選出合適複誦句。

questions.scenario: Daily routine: Time to go home.
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: It's four o'clock. Bye-bye!
questions.explanation: 報時對話。選項 B, C, D 無法導向後方的時間回答。
questions.commonMisconception: 疑問句選詞邏輯混亂。

questions.question: Which word has the long 'u' sound like in 'cute'?
questions.explanation: cute 與 tube 含有長母音 /u/。選項 B 為短母音 /ʌ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到字尾 e 對母音發音性質的改變。

questions.scenario: Asking for time to eat snacks.
questions.question:
A: Is it four o'clock now?
B: Yes, it is. __________________
questions.explanation: 確認時間後，緊接著描述該做什麼 (It's time for...)。選項 D 語法不對。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法將具體時間點與特定活動進行關聯描述串接。

questions.question: Choose the word with same sound as 'o' in 'no'.
questions.explanation: no 的 o 為長母音，與 boat 中的 oa 組合發音相同。選項 B 是短母音。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆單字母與組合字母發出相同長母音的規律。

questions.question:
A: Listen! What's that sound?
B: It's my big __________________. It's six o'clock!
questions.explanation: 具體發出聲音的物品 (單數)。選項 B 為複數；選項 C 為報時副詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合狀聲描述與名詞選詞。

questions.scenario: Final recap: What time do you wake up?
questions.question: I wake up at __________________.
questions.explanation: 正確的時間內容。由於句中已提供 at，後接時間補語。選項 D 會造成 at 重疊。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到填空位置前已存在介係詞 at。
